description:
Problem and representation: Solve a symmetric Euclidean TSP using a customer permutation and rounded distances. Nearest-neighbor construction creates an initial tour.

Iteration: Copy the current best tour, apply a double-bridge kick, then use 2-opt, Or-opt, and 3-opt local search. An improved candidate replaces the saved best. Stop at the configured time limit.

Boundary: The kick rearranges the tour without updating its position index before local search; this inconsistency was reproduced and can invalidate move evaluation. Rebuild that index and independently verify the result before reuse. The local 2-opt is independent of ALG-005. The script imports networkx and matplotlib even when drawing is not requested.
